Membership includes attached noncore fragments; core lists only core members. Both lists are sorted IDs." ✓

"For each coordinate of all members, let lo,hi be its min/max and sigma its population standard deviation. The generalized interval is [max(0,trunc(lo-sigma)),min(3028,trunc(hi+sigma))], where trunc is toward zero." ✓

"## Calibration and backup

A validation row matches a generalized interval pattern iff some contiguous real-prefix window of the same length lies inside every inclusive interval. A row contributes once per pattern, regardless of overlapping/repeated matches. For a cluster, hits[c] is the matching validation-row count of class c, and N[c] is that class's total validation-row count. For its target class t, Cin=hits[t]/N[t]; Cout=max(hits[c]/N[c] for c!=t), or0 if no other class. Its score is Cin/(Cout+1/10000). It is kept iff score>threshold. "The backup certificate uses its native tree-node order. A leaf is [class], where class is the smallest model.classes_ value with maximum leaf value. A branch is [feature_index,2*threshold,left_child_index,right_child_index]. Features are integers here, so twice the fitted midpoint threshold is integral. All certificate entries are JSON integers. Prediction takes left iff 2*feature<=2*threshold; input truncation/padding is the same as training." ✓

"## Tables and release banks

A range bank needs one entry per kept cluster. An exact bank has separate tables for each pattern length. Each pattern denotes its Cartesian product of integer interval values, excluding1514 at EVERY coordinate. Identical exact keys of the same length occupy one entry; their action is the highest-priority matching cluster. Keys of different lengths are distinct. The exact certificate entry count is min(actual distinct keys,capacity.exact+1). Only this clipped count is part of the certificate. Range counts are not clipped." ✓

"Operations have exactly these shapes: ..." ✓

"A resident bank is either current or pinned by at least one open epoch. Each ID occupies one bank even when current and pinned or reinstalled. When installing, the previous current bank can be evicted iff it has no open references. If the new bank alone exceeds its mode's capacity, status is oversize. Otherwise, if the prospective resident banks exceed either capacity, status is busy. Either failure leaves current/residents unchanged. Otherwise status is ok and the new bank becomes current. Reinstalling any supplied ID is allowed. Closing the last flow pinned to a noncurrent bank evicts it immediately. Classified-but-not-closed epochs STILL pin their bank. There is no automatic opening, expiry or final close: all opens must close by the end." ✓

"## Online behavior

Each epoch retains the release pinned at open, despite later successful installs. Its first packet fixes positive direction: encoded feature is1514+length for that src,1514-length for the other. Packet positions start at0 per epoch. Timestamps must be nondecreasing within an epoch, even AFTER classification; there is no cross-flow or cross-epoch timestamp ordering requirement.

For an unclassified arriving packet, idle backup has precedence if at least width packets were already consumed and the gap from the previous packet is STRICTLY larger than idle_us: commit backup BEFORE consuming the new packet. Otherwise consume it. A segment match concerns a contiguous suffix ending at this packet, with enough REAL packets for its length. At the earliest packet with any match, commit the highest-priority matching cluster immediately. A future match cannot replace this decision. If this packet has no match and the consumed count is STRICTLY greater than packet_limit, commit backup instead.

Backup always uses the FIRST width encoded features of the epoch, frozen once available. At an unclassified close, right-pad a shorter prefix with1514 and commit backup, including a completely empty flow. A gap before width packets does not classify or reset the epoch. Idle is checked only on an arriving packet, not on close or a timer. After commitment, packets bypass matching and backup, but timestamp validation and the open bank reference remain until close." ✓
